Every stage states what remains trusted after it ships, so the assurance claim shrinks visibly rather than being implied. Thermite's own stage documents adopted this by stage 3 — 'Residual trust and limits', 'Residual trust after G4' — and it is the discipline that keeps a certificate from reading as a guarantee. A surface proposal owes the same: which obligations it discharges, which it merely declares, and which it leaves to a trusted input with a name. The crash model is the worked example: which writes survive depends on the device, so it is stated as an assumption rather than presented as a fact about hardware.
